caseTitle.zh: 阿財伯的左腳與一條導絲
caseTitle.en: Uncle Tsai's left leg and a wire

condition.zh: 介入放射 · 下肢動脈阻塞

title.en: A day in the angio suite

tagline.zh: 鉛衣、顯影劑和一個不肯躺平的早上
tagline.en: Lead aprons, contrast and a morning that would not lie flat

desc.zh: 跟著羅主治做下肢血管攝影：術前核對、顯影劑病史、跨髂導絲、拔鞘壓迫、夜裡一通鼠蹊部的電話。腎功能沒抽，要不要等，決定的人是你。
desc.en: Lower-limb angiography with Dr Lo: the pre-procedure check, the contrast history, the crossover wire, pulling the sheath, a night call about a groin. Whether to wait for today's kidney function is your decision.

desc.zh: C 臂、鉛衣鉛玻璃、劑量與影像都在你手上；誰站在哪裡、照多久，由你盯。
desc.en: The C-arm, lead aprons and glass, dose and images are yours; who stands where and for how long is yours to watch.

about.zh: 判讀室用三台螢幕看世界，血管攝影室用一條導絲。保溫瓶還是空的，今天掛在鉛衣架上。
about.en: Three screens in the reading room, one wire in the angio suite. The thermos is still empty; today it hangs on the lead-apron rack.

about.zh: 管顯影劑、靜脈留置針、鎮靜監測與急救車。她說：打之前先知道車在哪、腎在哪。
about.en: Contrast, cannulas, sedation monitoring and the crash cart. Her rule: before you inject, know where the cart is and what the kidneys are doing.

role.zh: 六十八歲，左腳休息痛，腳趾潰瘍
role.en: Sixty-eight, left-foot rest pain, a toe ulcer

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。退休水電工，糖尿病，菸抽了四十年。拖鞋剪開一個洞給腳趾。他說上次打顯影劑「會癢」。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Retired plumber-electrician, diabetic, forty years of cigarettes. Cut a hole in his slipper for the toe. Says the last contrast “made me itchy”.

about.zh: 帶了一雙新拖鞋，還沒剪洞。她說：他躺不住，你們要一直跟他講話。
about.en: Brought a new pair of slippers, no hole yet. Her advice: he can't lie still, so keep talking to him.

about.zh: 推床推了二十年。推到血管攝影室的病人，他會先問：鼠蹊部有沒有壓好？
about.en: Twenty years pushing beds. Patients leaving the angio suite get one question from him: is the groin pressed properly?

about.zh: 想知道膝下還有幾條血管通。她會複誦，然後決定傷口要怎麼顧。
about.en: Wants to know how many vessels run below the knee. She reads back, then decides how to manage the wound.

about.zh: 電話開頭永遠是「我要一個 CT」。今天要學的是先說問題。
about.en: Every call starts with “I need a CT”. Today's lesson is to start with the question.

about.zh: 夜裡摸鼠蹊部摸得很仔細。腫一點她就打電話，寧可被罵。
about.en: Checks groins carefully at night. Calls at the first hint of swelling and would rather be told off.

plain.zh: 在影像導引下，從一個針孔用導絲和導管進去治療：打通血管、止血、引流。不開刀，但一樣是手術。
plain.en: Treatment through a needle hole under image guidance, with wires and catheters: opening vessels, stopping bleeding, draining collections. No incision, but still an operation.

plain.zh: 病灶在左腿，就從右邊鼠蹊部的動脈進去，導絲翻過骨盆的分叉到左邊。像從隔壁門進屋。
plain.en: The lesion is in the left leg, so you enter the artery at the right groin and steer the wire over the pelvic bifurcation to the left. Like entering the house by the neighbour's door.

plain.zh: 放在動脈入口的短管子，有單向閥，導絲導管從裡面進出。拔掉之後，洞要用手壓住。
plain.en: A short tube with a one-way valve sitting in the artery entry; wires and catheters pass through it. Once removed, the hole is held closed by hand.

plain.zh: 打進血管讓血管在 X 光下變白的藥水。可能過敏、可能傷腎，打之前要問清楚三件事。
plain.en: The liquid injected to make vessels show white under X-rays. It can cause allergy and harm kidneys, so three questions come before every injection.

plain.zh: 打顯影劑後幾天腎功能變差。糖尿病、腎本來就不好、脫水的人風險高；術前抽血、補水、依醫囑處理藥物。
plain.en: Kidney function worsening in the days after contrast. Diabetes, pre-existing kidney disease and dehydration raise the risk; check bloods before, hydrate, and manage medicines per order.

plain.zh: 穿刺前全隊停下來：病人、哪一邊、過敏、腎功能、抗凝血藥、器材。沒有人說「等一下」才開始。
plain.en: Everyone stops before the puncture: patient, which side, allergies, kidney function, anticoagulants, equipment. Only when nobody says “wait” do you begin.

plain.zh: 擋散射輻射的圍裙，加上甲狀腺圍領和眼鏡。穿在身上才算，掛在架上不算。
plain.en: The apron that blocks scattered radiation, plus a thyroid collar and glasses. It counts when it is on you, not on the rack.

plain.zh: 合理可行的最低劑量：時間短、距離遠、屏蔽好。透視的腳踩得越短，大家吃到的輻射越少。
plain.en: As low as reasonably achievable: less time, more distance, better shielding. The shorter the foot stays on the fluoroscopy pedal, the less everyone receives.

plain.zh: 拔鞘壓迫、緊張、痛，讓神經反射放慢心跳、拉低血壓：臉白、冒汗、想吐。平躺抬腿、繼續壓、叫人。
plain.en: Pressure on the groin, anxiety or pain triggers a reflex that slows the heart and drops the pressure: pale, sweaty, nauseated. Lie flat, legs up, keep pressing, call for help.

plain.zh: 拔鞘後用手指壓在穿刺點上方的動脈上一段時間，再逐漸放鬆。壓對位置比壓得用力重要。
plain.en: After the sheath comes out, fingers press the artery just above the puncture for a while, then ease off gradually. The right spot matters more than brute force.

plain.zh: 血從穿刺點漏到皮下，鼠蹊部腫起來。先壓、別讓病人坐起來、摸遠端脈搏、打電話給介入放射。
plain.en: Blood leaking from the puncture under the skin; the groin swells. Press first, keep the patient flat, feel the distal pulses, call interventional radiology.

plain.zh: 腳背和腳踝內側的脈搏。術前摸一次做基準，術後每次巡視都摸：變弱就是血管出事的第一個訊號。
plain.en: The pulses on the top of the foot and behind the inner ankle. Feel them once before as a baseline and at every check after: weakening is the first sign of vessel trouble.

plain.zh: 腳不動也痛，夜裡把腳垂到床下才舒服：表示血流已經少到連休息都不夠，比走路才痛嚴重得多。
plain.en: Pain in the foot even at rest, eased by hanging the leg off the bed at night: blood flow too low even for resting, far more serious than pain on walking.

plain.zh: 打顯影劑的電腦斷層，重組出整條血管的地圖。開刀或導管治療前的路線圖。
plain.en: A contrast CT reconstructed into a map of the whole vessel. The route plan before surgery or catheter treatment.

text.zh: 會轉的 X 光機。球管在下、影像板在上，離病人越近散射越少。腳離開踏板，影像就停，劑量也停。
text.en: The rotating X-ray machine. Tube below, detector above, closer to the patient means less scatter. Foot off the pedal and the image stops, and so does the dose.

text.zh: 會浮動的桌子，鋪無菌單。鼠蹊部穿刺、導絲、導管都在這裡。病人躺不住，就一直跟他說話。
text.en: A floating table under sterile drapes. Groin puncture, wires and catheters all happen here. If the patient cannot lie still, keep talking to him.

text.zh: 依設定把顯影劑推進血管。按下去之前，三個問題要先有答案：過敏、腎、抗凝血藥。
text.en: Pushes contrast into the vessel at a set rate. Before the button, three questions need answers: allergy, kidneys, anticoagulants.

text.zh: 放射師的位置：透視時間、劑量、影像儲存。玻璃後面的人負責提醒玻璃前面的人：腳放開。
text.en: The radiographer's seat: fluoroscopy time, dose, image storage. The person behind the glass reminds the people in front of it: foot off.

text.zh: 顯影劑反應、血管迷走反應、出血，都可能在這間房間發生。打之前先知道車在哪。
text.en: Contrast reactions, vasovagal reactions and bleeding can all happen in this room. Know where the cart is before you inject.

name.en: The slipper with the toe cut out

text.zh: 阿財伯自己剪的，給潰瘍的腳趾透氣。阿財嫂帶了新的來，他說：等腳好了再穿。
text.en: Cut by Uncle Tsai himself to give the ulcerated toe air. Mrs Tsai brought a new pair; he said he would wear them when the foot is better.

text.zh: 一、過敏：上次反應是什麼樣子？「會癢」是蕁麻疹，還是喘、血壓掉？細節決定要不要預防、要不要改做法。二、腎：今天的腎功能，不是上週的；糖尿病與脫水風險更高，相關藥物依醫囑處理。三、出血：抗凝血藥、抗血小板藥、血小板與凝血功能；鼠蹊部要壓多久，答案在這裡。三題都答了，才按注射器。
text.en: One, allergy: what exactly happened last time? “Itchy” may be hives or it may be wheeze and a falling pressure; the detail decides whether to premedicate or change the plan. Two, kidneys: today's function, not last week's; diabetes and dehydration raise the risk, and related medicines are managed per order. Three, bleeding: anticoagulants, antiplatelets, platelets and clotting; how long the groin is pressed is decided here. Only with all three answered does the injector fire.

text.zh: 時間：透視用點的，不用踩的；用上一張存下來的影像看路，不要一直照。距離：散射輻射隨距離快速減少，退一步少很多；打藥的時候站到鉛玻璃後面。屏蔽：鉛衣、甲狀腺圍領、鉛眼鏡、桌邊鉛簾、天花板鉛玻璃。劑量計戴在鉛衣外的領口。病人也要保護：準直器縮小照野、球管離病人遠一點、影像板貼近一點。
text.en: Time: tap the fluoroscopy pedal rather than hold it; navigate from the last stored image instead of continuous screening. Distance: scatter falls off quickly with distance, so one step back removes much of it; stand behind the lead glass during injections. Shielding: lead apron, thyroid collar, lead glasses, table-side drapes, the ceiling-mounted glass. Wear the dosimeter at the collar outside the apron. Protect the patient too: collimate tightly, keep the tube farther away and the detector closer.

text.zh: 拔鞘是手術的一部分，不是結束。徒手壓迫壓在穿刺點上方的動脈，位置比力氣重要；病人平躺、那條腿不彎，時間依流程。壓的時候看臉：發白冒汗心跳慢，是血管迷走反應，繼續壓、抬腿、叫人。之後的每一次巡視三件事：鼠蹊部有沒有血腫、遠端脈搏有沒有變弱、腳的顏色溫度。晚上腫一點就打電話，寧可被罵。
text.en: Pulling the sheath is part of the procedure, not the end of it. Manual compression sits on the artery just above the puncture, and position beats force; the patient lies flat with that leg straight for the time the protocol says. Watch the face while pressing: pale, sweaty and slow means a vasovagal reaction, so keep pressing, raise the legs, call for help. Every check afterwards asks three things: is there a haematoma in the groin, have the distal pulses weakened, what are the foot's colour and warmth. A slightly swollen groin at night earns a phone call, told off or not.

note.zh: 排程：第一台左腳；術前核對
note.en: Schedule: first case the left leg; the pre-procedure check

lines.zh: 血管攝影室早上七點四十五分。羅主治的空保溫瓶掛在鉛衣架上，像一件鉛衣。
lines.en: The angio suite, quarter to eight. Dr Lo's empty thermos hangs on the lead-apron rack like one more apron.

lines.zh: 第一台阿財伯，左腳休息痛加腳趾潰瘍，上週的電腦斷層血管攝影顯示左側淺股動脈長段阻塞。右邊鼠蹊部進，導絲翻過去。
lines.en: First case, Uncle Tsai: left-foot rest pain with a toe ulcer; last week's CT angiography showed a long occlusion of the left superficial femoral artery. In from the right groin, wire over the top.

lines.zh: 術前核對我們一起過。你排順序。
lines.en: We do the pre-procedure check together. You set the order.

q.zh: 介入放射術前核對的順序
q.en: The order of the pre-procedure check

steps.zh: 核對病人身分、手術部位與側別
同意書：風險、替代方案、簽名
抽血：腎功能、血小板、凝血功能
過敏與上次顯影劑反應的細節
steps.en: Allergies and details of any previous contrast reaction

steps.zh: 禁食、抗凝血藥、入路側的遠端脈搏基準

post.zh: 遠端脈搏術前摸一次。沒有基準，術後就不知道「變弱」是什麼意思。
post.en: Feel the distal pulses once before. Without a baseline, “weaker” means nothing afterwards.

guide.zh: 檢查 C 臂與屏蔽
guide.en: Check the C-arm and the shielding

lines.zh: 鉛衣、圍領、桌邊鉛簾、天花板鉛玻璃。C 臂在哪裡？先找到它。
lines.en: Aprons, collars, table drapes, the ceiling glass. Where is the C-arm? Find it first.

q.zh: 找到 C 臂，確認鉛簾與鉛玻璃就位
q.en: Find the C-arm and confirm the drapes and glass are in place

post.zh: 鉛衣穿在身上才算，掛在架上不算。羅主治，您的那件還在架上。
post.en: A lead apron counts on your body, not on the rack. Dr Lo, yours is still on the rack.

note.en: The details of “itchy”; last week's kidney function

guide.en: Meet Uncle Tsai in the prep bay

lines.zh: 醫生，我上次打那個顯影劑會癢。還要打嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, last time that contrast made me itchy. Do I need it again?

lines.zh: 他躺不住，你們要一直跟他講話。
lines.en: He can't lie still; you'll need to keep talking to him.

lines.zh: 「會癢」是什麼樣子的癢？這題的答案決定今天怎麼做。問清楚。
lines.en: What kind of itchy was “itchy”? The answer decides how today goes. Ask properly.

post.zh: 手臂起幾個疹子，半小時就消了。沒有喘。
post.en: A few welts on the arm, gone in half an hour. No wheezing.

post.zh: 輕度蕁麻疹。依流程處理，記在單子上，急救車我推近一點。
post.en: Mild hives. Managed per protocol, written on the sheet, and I'll bring the crash cart closer.

guide.zh: 到工作站看上週的血管攝影
guide.en: Last week's CT angiography at the workstation

lines.zh: 路線圖。阻塞在哪、多長、膝下幾條血管通。沒看過地圖的人不要進門。
lines.en: The route map. Where the occlusion is, how long, how many vessels run below the knee. Nobody enters without reading the map.

question.zh: 左腳休息痛的電腦斷層血管攝影，你要先回答哪三個問題？
question.en: On a CT angiography for left-foot rest pain, which three questions come first?

answer.zh: 一、入路：右側股動脈與骨盆分叉能不能讓導絲翻過去。二、病灶：左側淺股動脈阻塞的起點、長度、鈣化程度。三、流出道：膝下有幾條血管通到腳，這決定打通以後血流去哪裡、傷口會不會好。
answer.en: One, access: can a wire from the right femoral artery cross the pelvic bifurcation. Two, the lesion: where the left superficial femoral occlusion starts, its length, how calcified. Three, run-off: how many vessels reach the foot below the knee, which decides where the flow goes once opened and whether the ulcer will heal.

post.zh: 膝下兩條通。傷口有機會。
post.en: Two vessels below the knee. The ulcer has a chance.

lines.zh: 病房送來的腎功能是上週的，今天沒抽。他糖尿病，昨晚禁食又沒掛點滴。
lines.en: The kidney function the ward sent is last week's; nothing drawn today. He is diabetic, fasted overnight, and had no drip.

q.zh: 今天的腎功能沒抽。你怎麼做？
q.en: No kidney function from today. What do you do?

options.zh: 先抽、補水，等結果再進房
options.en: Draw it now, hydrate, wait for the result

why.zh: 顯影劑腎病變的風險就是他：糖尿病、禁食、脫水。等一小時，比等腎臟科會診便宜。
why.en: He is the textbook risk for contrast-associated kidney injury: diabetic, fasted, dry. An hour's wait is cheaper than a nephrology consult.

options.zh: 上週的報告正常，照排程做
options.en: Last week's was normal; run to schedule

why.zh: 上週的腎不是今天的腎。禁食一晚什麼都會變。
why.en: Last week's kidneys are not today's. A night of fasting changes everything.

options.zh: 顯影劑打少一點就沒關係

why.zh: 少不等於安全，而且你還不知道腎在哪裡。
why.en: Less is not safe, and you still do not know where the kidneys stand.

post.zh: 排程往後一小時。阿忠，去跟下一台說。
post.en: Schedule slips an hour. Chung, go and tell the next case.

post.zh: 我順便問他鼠蹊部有沒有壓好。
post.en: I'll ask him if his groin is pressed properly while I'm there.

note.zh: 時間暫停；導絲翻過分叉
note.en: Time-out; the wire crosses the bifurcation

lines.zh: 時間暫停。你來。
lines.en: Time-out. You lead.

lines.zh: 阿財伯，六十八歲，左下肢血管攝影併可能的氣球擴張，右側股動脈入路。
lines.en: Uncle Tsai, sixty-eight, left lower-limb angiography with possible angioplasty, right femoral access.

lines.zh: 過敏：顯影劑輕度蕁麻疹，已依流程處理。今天腎功能正常，無抗凝血藥，遠端脈搏已摸。
lines.en: Allergy: mild contrast hives, managed per protocol. Kidney function normal today, no anticoagulants, baseline distal pulses recorded.

lines.zh: 急救車在門邊，靜脈留置針通暢。
lines.en: Crash cart by the door, cannula running.

lines.zh: 我躺好了。可以開始了嗎？我要跟你們聊水電。
lines.en: I'm lying still. Can we start? I'm going to talk plumbing at you.

lines.zh: 對側股動脈入路。導絲到分叉，翻過去，不要頂血管壁。看螢幕，不要看手。
lines.en: Contralateral femoral access. Wire to the bifurcation, over the top, never against the wall. Watch the screen, not your hands.

post.zh: 過了。導管跟上，打一張路線圖。
post.en: Across. Catheter follows; one road-map run.
This is harder than clearing a drain.

guide.en: Watch the dose from the control room

lines.zh: 透視時間已經累積不少。羅主治，用上一張存的影像看路，腳放開。
lines.en: Fluoroscopy time is adding up. Dr Lo, navigate from the last stored image; foot off the pedal.

lines.zh: 放開了。ALARA 是放射師喊的，不是醫師記得的。
lines.en: Off. ALARA is something the radiographer calls, not something the doctor remembers.

lines.zh: 準直器縮小一點，影像板貼近一點。打藥的時候大家退到鉛玻璃後面。
lines.en: Collimate tighter, detector closer. Everyone behind the lead glass for the injection.

note.en: Manual compression; a face goes pale

lines.zh: 氣球擴張做完，血流下去了。拔鞘。手指壓在穿刺點上方的動脈上，看他的臉。
lines.en: Angioplasty done, flow restored. Sheath out. Fingers on the artery just above the puncture, and watch his face.

lines.zh: 你壓著。一分鐘後，阿財伯不聊水電了。臉白、冒汗，監視器的心跳慢下來。
lines.en: You press. A minute later Uncle Tsai stops talking plumbing. Pale, sweating, and the monitor's heart rate slows.

lines.zh: 我……想吐。
lines.en: I… feel sick.

options.zh: 繼續壓迫，平躺抬腿，叫人，依醫囑處理
options.en: Keep pressing, flat with legs raised, call for help, treat per order

why.zh: 血管迷走反應。手不能離開鼠蹊部，離開就是出血。另一個人處理血壓與心跳。
why.en: A vasovagal reaction. The hand does not leave the groin; leaving means bleeding. Someone else manages the pressure and the heart rate.

options.en: Let go and fetch the crash cart

why.zh: 放開的那隻手，會換來一個血腫。叫人推車，你的手留在原地。
why.en: The hand that lets go buys a haematoma. Call for the cart; your hand stays where it is.

why.zh: 血壓在掉的人不坐起來，拔鞘的腿更不能彎。
why.en: A falling pressure does not sit up, and a freshly pulled groin does not bend.

post.zh: 腳抬了，依醫囑處理了。心跳回來，臉色回來。你的手沒動，好。
post.en: Legs up, treated per order. Rate's back, colour's back. Your hand never moved. Good.

post.zh: 剛剛看到我阿公。他說水管接錯了。
post.en: I just saw my grandfather. He said I'd plumbed it wrong.

sub.zh: 阿財伯做得怎麼樣？膝下幾條通？
sub.en: How did Uncle Tsai go? How many vessels below the knee?

lines.zh: 阿財伯，左側淺股動脈長段阻塞，已氣球擴張，血流到足部。流出道：膝下兩條通。
lines.en: Uncle Tsai: long left superficial femoral occlusion, angioplastied, flow to the foot. Run-off: two vessels below the knee.

lines.zh: 拔鞘管時有血管迷走反應，已處理恢復。右鼠蹊部徒手壓迫完成，遠端脈搏與術前相同。
lines.en: A vasovagal reaction when the sheath came out, treated and recovered. Right groin compressed, distal pulses as before.

lines.zh: 複誦：淺股動脈已開通、膝下兩條、迷走反應已恢復、脈搏同術前。傷口我們接手。謝謝。
lines.en: Read-back: superficial femoral open, two vessels below the knee, vasovagal recovered, pulses unchanged. We'll take the wound from here. Thank you.

note.zh: 「我要一個 CT」→ 先說問題
note.en: “I need a CT” → start with the question

sub.zh: 我要一個下肢 CT，右腳突然痛
sub.en: I need a lower-limb CT; a right leg suddenly painful

lines.zh: 我要一個下肢 CT。病人右腳突然痛、冰冷、摸不到脈搏，兩小時前開始。
lines.en: I need a lower-limb CT. Right leg suddenly painful, cold, no pulse, started two hours ago.

lines.zh: 先說問題。突然、冰冷、無脈，問題是「急性動脈阻塞在哪裡、能不能馬上處理」。選影像先問問題。
lines.en: Start with the question. Sudden, cold, pulseless: the question is “where is the acute arterial occlusion and can it be treated now”. Choose imaging around the question.

post.zh: 急性肢體缺血是血管急症。電腦斷層血管攝影可以，但先打給血管外科，不要讓影像排程變成等待的理由。
post.en: Acute limb ischaemia is a vascular emergency. CT angiography is reasonable, but call vascular surgery first; imaging must not become a reason to wait.

post.zh: 複誦：先通知血管外科，電腦斷層血管攝影馬上排。我學到了：先說問題。
post.en: Read-back: vascular surgery first, CT angiography now. Lesson learned: start with the question.

note.zh: 鼠蹊部、遠端脈搏、腳的顏色
note.en: Groin, distal pulses, the foot's colour

lines.zh: 三件事：鼠蹊部平、沒有血腫；遠端脈搏跟術前一樣；腳比早上溫，顏色也回來了。
lines.en: Three things: groin flat, no haematoma; distal pulses as before; the foot is warmer than this morning and the colour is back.

lines.zh: 腳趾不痛了。昨天晚上我還把腳垂在床下睡。
lines.en: The toe's stopped hurting. Last night I slept with my foot hanging off the bed.

lines.zh: 那叫休息痛。今天晚上試試看把腳放回床上。
lines.en: That is rest pain. Tonight, try keeping the foot on the bed.

lines.zh: 新拖鞋先穿？
lines.en: New slippers now?

lines.zh: 等腳好了再穿。這雙剪開的先留著。
lines.en: When the foot's better. The cut-open pair stays for now.

lines.zh: 今天四件事：顯影劑前三個問題；今天的腎不是上週的腎；壓迫的手不離開；ALARA 是放射師喊的。
lines.en: Four things today: three questions before contrast; today's kidneys are not last week's; the compressing hand never leaves; ALARA is the radiographer's call.

lines.zh: 還有，介入放射不開刀，但一樣是手術。時間暫停不是形式。
lines.en: And interventional radiology makes no incision, but it is still an operation. The time-out is not a formality.

lines.zh: 他從鉛衣架上拿下保溫瓶，搖了搖。空的。他還是帶走了。
lines.en: He takes the thermos off the apron rack and shakes it. Empty. He takes it anyway.

note.zh: 鼠蹊部腫一點：壓、平躺、摸脈搏
note.en: A slightly swollen groin: press, flat, feel the pulses

sub.zh: 阿財伯右鼠蹊部腫一點，怎麼辦？
sub.en: Uncle Tsai's right groin is slightly swollen. What now?

lines.zh: 阿財伯右鼠蹊部比下午腫一點，不大，他說不痛。我先打電話，寧可被罵。
lines.en: Uncle Tsai's right groin is a little more swollen than this afternoon, not large, no pain. I'm calling first; tell me off if you like.

lines.zh: 打得對。現在用手壓在穿刺點上方，讓他平躺、腿伸直，摸腳背脈搏跟下午比。我十分鐘到。
lines.en: Right call. Press just above the puncture now, keep him flat with the leg straight, and compare the foot pulse with this afternoon's. I'll be there in ten minutes.

lines.zh: 複誦：壓穿刺點上方、平躺腿直、摸遠端脈搏比較、你十分鐘到。
lines.en: Read-back: press above the puncture, flat with the leg straight, compare distal pulses, you in ten minutes.

lines.zh: 還有，晚上的腎功能報告出來了，跟早上一樣。
lines.en: And the evening kidney function is back; same as this morning.

lines.zh: 你走過去的路上想：早上多等的那一小時，現在睡得著。
lines.en: On the way over you think: the hour you waited this morning is why you will sleep tonight.

lines.zh: 還有，晚上的腎功能比上週差，值班醫師已經會診腎臟科。
lines.en: And the evening kidney function is worse than last week's; the duty doctor has already called nephrology.

lines.zh: 你走過去的路上想：早上少等的那一小時，今天晚上有人替他付。腎，要等幾天才知道。
lines.en: On the way over you think: the hour you skipped this morning is being paid for tonight by someone else. The kidneys will take days to answer.

guide.en: Feel the pulses at the bedside

lines.zh: 手不離開穿刺點上方。腳背脈搏……跟下午一樣。
lines.en: Hand stays above the puncture. Foot pulse... same as this afternoon.

lines.zh: 鼠蹊部壓一壓就平了，脈搏一樣。阿財伯打了個呵欠：「水電師傅都比你們早睡。」
lines.en: The groin settles under pressure; the pulses are unchanged. Uncle Tsai yawns: 'Even plumbers go to bed before you lot.'

sub.zh: 今天的腎不是上週的腎；壓迫的手不離開
sub.en: Today's kidneys are not last week's; the pressing hand never leaves
